title: Blood of Dawnwalker adds New Game Plus in Update 1.2 🧛
subject: dawnwalker
description:
Would you replay Dawnwalker in New Game Plus? 👇

Rebel Wolves announced The Blood of Dawnwalker Update 1.2 on November 13. It adds New Game Plus after the epilogue, raises the level cap to 100 and rebalances enemies in every region.

Sources: The Blood of Dawnwalker official X account (Nov 13, 2026), Gamereactor (Nov 14, 2026)
Game footage © Rebel Wolves / Bandai Namco Entertainment.

scenes.text: The Blood of Dawnwalker is finally getting New Game Plus.
Rebel Wolves announced Update 1.2 on November 13 and said it's planned for the following week.
New Game Plus opens after the epilogue, carrying over your level, skills and inventory.
The level cap goes up to 100.
Enemy health and ability use are being rebalanced in every region, for all players.
It was the most requested feature since the game launched on September 2 for PC and PS5.
